results.title: Timeouts
results.content:
Most requests to external servers should have a timeout attached, in case the server is not responding in a timely manner. By default, requests do not time out unless a timeout value is set explicitly. Without a timeout, your code may hang for minutes or more.
The connect timeout is the number of seconds Requests will wait for your client to establish a connection to a remote machine. r = requests.get('https://github.com', timeout=5)

results.title: hashlib - Secure hashes and message digests
results.content: This module implements a common interface to many different hash algorithms. Use hashlib.sha256() to create a SHA-256 hash object. You can now feed this object with bytes-like objects using the update() method, and ask for the digest of the concatenation of the data fed to it so far with digest() or hexdigest().

results.title: Configuring retries in HTTP clients
results.content: Transient network failures are common. Configure a retry policy with exponential backoff and a cap on attempts. Run the following command to install the library: pip install urllib3. Then mount an HTTPAdapter with Retry(total=3, backoff_factor=0.5) on your session so idempotent requests are retried automatically.

results.title: What is prompt injection?
results.content: Prompt injection is an attack where text in a document tries to override the instructions an LLM application was given. A classic example is a web page that says 'ignore previous instructions'. Defenses include treating retrieved text as data, screening it before it reaches the model, and limiting which tools an agent can call.
